metadata.name: Run Compass [REP+]
metadata.description: Fair-play dynamic route and build guidance for every vanilla character in solo Normal and Hard Repentance+ runs. Compare visible collectibles, actives, trinkets, cards, pills, shops, rerolls, machines, and resource timing against your selected goal. Mod Config Menu is recommended for settings; base routing uses safe defaults without it. Repentogon and EID are optional enhancements.
